entities.name: Stalinist Era & the Forest Brothers
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The second Soviet occupation, the massive March 1949 deportation of over 20,000 Estonians, forced collectivisation, and the Forest Brothers (metsavennad) guerrilla resistance lasting into the 1950s. The destruction of Estonian civil society.
